svg.text: Visit the next node of the random path
Take its data event: the n = 50 closest simulated nodes
Compute the mismatch at every position of the training image
Draw one of the k = 2.4 best positions
Paste the value of that position into the simulation
Done: 2 500 nodes simulated, each one from the training image
Empty data event: every position fits equally well
Mismatch = share of the 1 neighbours that differ
Mismatch = share of the 50 neighbours that differ
No simulated node yet: the data event is empty
The grid is filled one node at a time, following a random path
… and so on for every node, faster
… until the whole grid is simulated
